title: $\Psi$-0.6: Adaptive Streams of Thought in a Unified Vision-Language World Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.32177v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Humans reason about the physical world by flexibly combining different forms of inference as a problem unfolds. Achieving this flexibility is a major open challenge in AI: capabilities often remain separated across specialized models, limiting how they can be composed and jointly adapted to a task. We introduce $\Psi$-0.6, a unified vision-language world model that adaptively composes perception, language, geometry, and simulation within a shared reasoning process we call streams of thought. These streams interleave images, text, and explicit representations of geometry and motion, all of which the model can generate and interpret through a shared token interface. $\Psi$-0.6 surpasses leading open-weight models zero-shot on multi-view spatial reasoning, with further gains from reasoning through geometric intermediates. translated_title: Ψ-0.6：统一视觉-语言世界模型中的自适应思维流
translated_abstract: 人类在问题展开的过程中，会灵活地结合不同形式的推理来思考物理世界。实现这种灵活性是人工智能领域一个重大的开放性挑战：各种能力往往分散在不同的专用模型之中，限制了它们的组合方式以及共同适应任务的能力。我们提出了 Ψ-0.6，一个统一的视觉-语言世界模型，它能够在一个我们称为“思维流”的共享推理过程中自适应地组合感知、语言、几何与模拟。这些思维流交替穿插图像、文本以及几何与运动的显式表示，模型可以通过统一的 token 接口生成并解释所有这些内容。Ψ-0.6 在多视角空间推理任务上零样本超越了领先的开放权重模型，并且通过基于几何中间表示的推理获得了进一步提升。它还支持反事实模拟：通过生成并解释想象中的场景来判断，例如，某……
tldr: Ψ-0.6 是一个统一的视觉-语言世界模型，通过在共享的“思维流”推理过程中自适应地组合感知、语言、几何与模拟能力，在多视角空间推理上零样本超越领先的开放权重模型，并支持基于想象场景的反事实模拟。
en_tdlr: Ψ-0.6 is a unified vision-language world model that adaptively composes perception, language, geometry, and simulation within shared "streams of thought," surpassing leading open-weight models zero-shot on multi-view spatial reasoning and supporting counterfactual simulation through imagined scenes.
